verdict.rationale: A government IP registry could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary for bulk or API access, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only human-facing gov.uk guidance (online forms, paper filing, web search) and never mentions an API, schema, or data dictionary. The probe found that the trade-mark search host blocks automated agents at robots.txt, which points to no open machine channel being documented here.
